verdict.rationale: The official LibreOffice repo says an SDK exists for developing extensions, with API docs and a Developers Guide (gh-1). The start-parameter docs describe headless mode and UNO acceptor strings so external clients can drive LibreOffice through its API (docs-2, docs-3). Hands-on reports point to a poor developer experience: one user gave up on macro automation with Basic and Python APIs, and another could not find docs for a JavaScript API for Calc (comm-12, comm-14). These limit depth rather than contradict that the SDK exists. Missing for 10: detail on which SDK languages and bindings are supported, in-depth first-party SDK documentation in the pack, and positive independent corroboration of building against the SDK.
